svg.title: Same 128 useful read bytes; different sector demand
svg.text: Same 128 useful read bytes; different sector demand
4 requested 32-byte sectors = 128 bytes coverage; useful fraction 100%.
5 requested sectors = 160 bytes coverage; useful fraction 80%.
Stride of 8 elements (32 bytes) between lanes
32 requested sectors = 1,024 bytes coverage; useful fraction 12.5%.
Isolated warp address model: these counts are not measured DRAM traffic or speedups.
Prior accesses and neighboring warps can change cache reuse at each memory level.
